summary.description: Reliance lists INR21700-RS50 as a 5Ah 21700 cell with a 70A maximum continuous value subject to an 80°C cutoff. Its available specification states at least 4950mAh minimum capacity, and Battery Mooch retested March 2026 production cells and estimated 40A continuous current. Retain batch identity and distinguish the independent 40A catalog candidate from the manufacturer's temperature-limited maximum. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
The conservative 40A value is supported by the independent production-cell retest; 70A remains temperature-limited.
The exact-model retest covered production cells, but future batches and wrappers still require continuity checks.
Runtime catalog admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.
The catalog entry retains its measured and specification limits; default visibility remains a separate editorial decision.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is Reliance INR21700-RS50 (INR21700-RS50), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
Reliance identifies INR21700-RS50 as a 5Ah 21700 cell; its available specification states minimum capacity of 4950mAh and a 70A maximum continuous discharge with an 80°C cutoff.
Battery Mooch retested March 2026 production cells and estimated 40A continuous current; 70A is temperature-limited and remains distinct from the conservative catalog candidate.
The exact Reliance INR21700-RS50 has exact-model vaping test coverage.
A current European retailer lists the exact Reliance RS50 21700 cell individually and provides model-specific documentation links, supporting commercial availability.
The current 76-entry Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact Reliance INR21700-RS50 identity.

safetyFindings.summary: The manufacturer specification and independent test distinguish the conservative 40A continuous candidate from the 70A maximum that requires temperature control.
